lead.event: Singapore Core CBD Grade A office rents rise 2% in Q3 2026
lead.headline: Core CBD Grade A office rents rise 2% in Q3 2026
lead.blurb: The monthly rate reached $12.75 psf, the strongest quarterly increase since 3Q2022. AI companies added to leasing demand, with Anthropic reportedly committing to 100 desks at The Executive Centre and OpenAI in advanced negotiations for about 120,000 sq ft at Shaw Tower. CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield and Newmark forecast 4% to 5% or higher rental growth for 2026, amid limited new supply before 2028.

deals_control.event: Bukit Sembawang agrees to acquire the Kallang DistriPark site
deals_control.headline: Bukit Sembawang agrees to acquire part of Kallang site at estimated S$1.01 billion
deals_control.blurb: Its subsidiaries signed a conditional agreement with Tropical Warehousing to buy 5.1ha of land and buildings for S$196.04 million, with estimated total land cost of about S$1.01 billion including lease-upgrade premium and land betterment charges. The planned residential development could yield 600 to 800 condominium units and requires shareholder approval at an upcoming extraordinary general meeting, as well as in-principle approval from the Singapore Land Authority for a fresh 99-year lease.

deals_control.event: GIC and Primary Health Properties form a £700 million healthcare-property joint venture
deals_control.headline: GIC and Primary Health Properties form £700 million healthcare-property joint venture
deals_control.blurb: Primary Health Properties will contribute 27 private hospitals and receive £500 million to repay the bridging loan for its Assura acquisition and another debt facility. The deal will reduce its net debt to around £2.9 billion.

deals_control.event: Keppel REIT agrees to acquire a 51% stake in Keppel South Central
deals_control.headline: Keppel REIT agrees to buy 51% of Keppel South Central for S$610.9 million
deals_control.blurb: The conditional agreement is with sponsor Keppel, and the acquisition is expected to add 2.01% to pro forma DPU. Unitholder approval is required at an EGM expected in 4Q2026, with completion targeted for 2Q2027.

deals_control.event: Keppel-linked consortium seeks to sell Shanghai's International Bund Gateway
deals_control.headline: Keppel-linked consortium seeks to sell International Bund Gateway for 3 billion yuan
deals_control.blurb: The asking price is about 35% below the 4.6 billion yuan paid in 2019 by Keppel Land China, Keppel Capital’s AAMTF III and co-investors. Savills is the sole marketing agent, and the sale aims to repay debt tied to the asset.

market_structure_policy.event: Singapore's haze crackdown prompts plantation-company responses and share-price reactions
market_structure_policy.headline: Singapore haze crackdown prompts response as First Resources shares fall over 14%
market_structure_policy.blurb: On 19 October, Senior Minister K. Shanmugam said Singapore would seek more information from First Resources and Bumitama Agri. First Resources welcomed an evidence-based investigation on 20 October, offering satellite hotspot timelines and firefighting records and saying it was confident a review would confirm it had not used fire to clear land.

market_structure_policy.event: Taiwan blocks Grab's acquisition of foodpanda's Taiwan business
market_structure_policy.headline: Taiwan blocks Grab's US$600 million foodpanda acquisition
market_structure_policy.blurb: The proposed all-cash purchase of foodpanda's Taiwan business from Delivery Hero would have added about 13% to Grab's delivery gross merchandise value and US$60 million to its 2028 adjusted EBITDA, according to Morningstar analyst Kai Wang. Taiwan's Fair Trade Commission said the deal would significantly affect local competition and rejected Grab's proposed remedies as insufficient and unenforceable.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Mi Material launches its SGX Mainboard IPO
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Mi Material launches SGX Mainboard IPO at S$1.80 a share
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Seven cornerstone investors, including Amova Asset Management Asia, Fullerton Fund Management and Manulife Investment Management, have committed to subscribe for about 41.94 million new shares. Expected net proceeds are S$157.9 million. Mi Material plans to list on 28 October at 2pm and use proceeds for facility and research expansion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Carro establishes a S$450 million asset-backed securitisation facility
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Carro establishes S$450 million asset-backed securitisation facility
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The warehouse facility is backed by Singapore auto loan receivables originated by its wholly owned subsidiary Genie Financial Services, and is intended to optimise financing and diversify long-term funding. Mizuho Bank arranged the facility, with HSBC and JP Morgan as lenders and note subscribers.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Eni announces an extraordinary dividend and increases its share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Eni announces about €1.3 billion extraordinary dividend, lifts 2026 buyback to €3.8 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The buyback rises from €3.4 billion after increases in April and July. Higher energy prices and refining margins amid the Middle East war buoyed cash flow, while third-quarter adjusted net income was €2.8 billion, above the €2.5 billion average analyst estimate.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Deluge Corp begins trading on the SGX Mainboard
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Deluge Corp begins SGX Mainboard trading, closes 6.7% higher at S$0.64
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: It opened at S$0.63, 5% above its S$0.60 offer price, after the IPO was 3.86 times subscribed. The IPO and a cornerstone tranche of 23.4 million new shares raised about S$23.4 million gross, with net proceeds of about S$20.1 million expected to fund expansion, working capital and strategic initiatives.

earnings_guidance.event: Meta raises its 2026 capital expenditure outlook and announces a stock dividend
earnings_guidance.headline: Meta lifts 2026 capex outlook to US$135-145 billion and announces stock dividend
earnings_guidance.blurb: The new non-voting shares will be distributed as a stock dividend, effectively a two-for-one split, with trading expected from January 2027. Meta says the class will support fundraising, employee compensation and acquisitions while helping ensure Mark Zuckerberg continues to lead the company.

earnings_guidance.event: RHB lowers its target price for Singapore Exchange
earnings_guidance.headline: RHB lowers Singapore Exchange target price to S$20.30
earnings_guidance.blurb: RHB maintained a neutral rating after implied first-half FY2027 securities and derivatives activity tracked 7.4% and 10.2% below its expectations. It cut FY2027, FY2028 and FY2029 earnings forecasts by 8.3%, 8.4% and 8.5%, respectively, and now expects recurring net-profit growth to slow to 5% in FY2027 from 21.1% in FY2026.

earnings_guidance.event: DBS downgrades Jardine Matheson Southeast Asia to Hold
earnings_guidance.headline: DBS downgrades Jardine Matheson Southeast Asia to Hold, cuts target to S$25
earnings_guidance.blurb: DBS Group Research said near-term value-unlocking potential is largely priced in, with the company trading at about a 20 per cent premium to pro forma NAV and more than 85 per cent of gross asset value tied to Astra International. It cut FY2026 and FY2027 earnings forecasts by 5 per cent and 10 per cent, respectively, and said Astra’s investor day on 16 November could be a catalyst for both stocks.

earnings_guidance.event: DBS raises its target price for Yangzijiang Shipbuilding
earnings_guidance.headline: DBS raises Yangzijiang Shipbuilding target price to S$6.60
earnings_guidance.blurb: DBS Group Research raised its target from S$5.60 and reiterated a BUY rating. Its 15 October report forecasts US$6.5 billion in FY2026 orders, up from US$4.5 billion, and expects the orderbook to exceed a record US$25 billion, providing visibility through 2030.

macro_flows.event: Oil prices rise after an attack on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah field
macro_flows.headline: Oil rises after attack on Saudi Aramco’s Shaybah field, with Brent above US$110
macro_flows.blurb: A drone strike on the field killed two people, but operations were unaffected. West Texas Intermediate rose toward US$98 a barrel after swinging in a US$4 range, while Brent has surged almost 80% this year following a US-Iran war that disrupted Persian Gulf energy flows.
